llm.summary: This skill is a document-template helper for internal company communications and does not contain code, install hooks, persistence, or hidden data export behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe templates and drafting guidance for weekly reports, project updates, incident reports, cross-department emails, FAQs, and general internal communications.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Several templates tell the agent to gather context from available internal sources such as chat, documents, email, and calendar; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should keep access limited to authorized teams, topics, and date ranges.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown templates and a simple package.json with no dependencies, scripts, executable files, or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of internal communications and company documents is proportionate for this drafting task, but those sources may contain confidential business or employee information.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, credential handling, privilege escalation, mutation command, or automatic sending/posting behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable letting the agent use authorized internal chat, documents, email, or calendar context to draft communications. Do not grant it access to broad company data unless that scope is needed, and review drafts before sharing because the skill can summarize sensitive internal information.
llm.findings:
[unicode-control-chars] unexpected: The observable issue is consistent with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings in package.json, not hidden bidirectional text or prompt-injection content.
[staticScan-clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, matching the artifact review of non-executable markdown templates.
[SkillSpector-clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; independent review found no artifact-backed malicious or suspicious behavior.
[VirusTotal-clean] expected: VirusTotal showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not solely determine the benign verdict.
